captures.coverage_semantics: Strong candidate for a full daily status feed, but the actual dated files and distribution access for these ETFs were not obtained. File availability/published-at timestamps for the requested window are unknown.

captures.source: Shenzhen Stock Exchange fund/ETF technical exchange interface specification TS03
captures.source_class: official technical specification; not ETF-own-status data

captures.coverage_semantics: This describes constituent security status, not the ETF's own exchange execution state; excluded as a source for 159612/159952 daily tradability.
